# Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We want Moonrise Studio discussions, issues, and security reports to stay
respectful and useful for freelancers, creators, and local businesses.

## Expected behavior

- Be respectful and constructive
- Focus on the product problem and user impact
- Respect privacy and do not share other people’s personal data
- Report security issues privately (see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md))

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, hate, or personal attacks
- Spam, scams, or phishing
- Publishing private vulnerability details before a fix is available
- Sharing secrets, tokens, or customer data in public issues

## Enforcement

Reports can be sent to [trymoonrise@gmail.com](mailto:trymoonrise@gmail.com).
We may remove content, close issues, or block accounts that break this policy.

## Scope

This applies to GitHub spaces for this repository and official Moonrise support
channels tied to [trymoonrise.com](https://trymoonrise.com).
